cells.gaps: No fact says SYGIDAN Recettes is live in any commune: it was at pre-validation in April 2024, and in December 2025 one commune was handed its taxpayer database within the pilot. Register and shared describe the design, not use; no count of communes recording is given. The costed plan (CIV-021) ran to June 2024 and is not current at the as-at, and no last-twelve-months fact is held.
cells.note: A register system in a 22-commune pilot of 201, with general distribution announced and not reported. Stage 3 needs it past its pilot and live in communes outside the capital.
